title: [CRM] upon applying acl.json , crm stats for available counter is reduced by 6 , while  used count is 2
author: chitra-raghavan
body:
**Description**

In broadcom platforms (Z9100) While  running [crm_test_acl_counter.yml](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/ansible/roles/test/tasks/crm/crm_test_acl_counter.yml) ,  upon applying [acl.json](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/ansible/roles/test/tasks/crm/acl.json) , the counter , "crm_stats_acl_counter_available" is decremented by value 6, but "crm_stats_acl_counter_used"  just 2 and hence the testcase fails 
is  this expected  in broadcom platforms  ? 


**Before applying acl**
```
127.0.0.1:6379[2]> hgetall "CRM:ACL_TABLE_STATS:0x7000000000a3e"
1) "crm_stats_acl_counter_used"
2) "0"
3) "crm_stats_acl_entry_used"
4) "0"
5) "crm_stats_acl_counter_available"
6) "30208"
7) "crm_stats_acl_entry_available"
8) "512"
```

**After applying acl :** 

```
root@sonic-z9100-02:~# acl-loader update full acl.json

127.0.0.1:6379[2]> hgetall "CRM:ACL_TABLE_STATS:0x7000000000a3e"
1) "crm_stats_acl_counter_used"
2) "2"  << used counter is incremented by 2 
3) "crm_stats_acl_entry_used"
4) "2"
5) "crm_stats_acl_counter_available"
6) "30202"    <<<<<<<<<<<< 6 values are decremented in available counter
7) "crm_stats_acl_entry_available"
8) "510"
```

**After deleting the acl**

root@sonic-z9100-02:~#  acl-loader delete

```
127.0.0.1:6379[2]> hgetall "CRM:ACL_TABLE_STATS:0x7000000000a3e"
1) "crm_stats_acl_counter_used"
2) "0"
3) "crm_stats_acl_entry_used"
4) "0"
5) "crm_stats_acl_counter_available"
6) "30208"
7) "crm_stats_acl_entry_available"
8) "512"

```

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. apply acl
2. check the crm acl counters , available vs used
